sentences.text:
Shri Neeraj Sharma, Government Advocate for the
 State/ respondents.
Heard on I.A. No. 1 of 2017, an application for grant of stay.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner has been convicted by respondent No.2 under Section 30(2) of Food Safety and Standards Act,2006 and sentenced with fine accordingly.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Act,2006 and
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The provisions quoted in the impugned order provide for the functions of the Commissioner of Food Safety of the State, which clearly shows non-application of mind by respondent No.2.

It is submitted that although there is a provision of appeal in this matter to the Appellate Authority as provided under the Act, but the same has not been constituted by the State Government till date and hence this petition.
Learned counsel for respondent No.1 seeks time to file reply.
List this case after four weeks for filing reply.
Notice to respondents is dispensed with as they are represented.
In the meanwhile, the effect and operation of the impugned order shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.

Sd /-
